name: dsh-vibe-trading
description: Interactive trading research workbench for DeepSeek Harness — orchestrated plan→data→compute→explain loop where every number comes from a deterministic layer (LLM interprets, never produces figures). Honest-unavailable semantics, source metadata riding on every dataset, out-of-sample backtest discipline, MACD/RSI/correlation indicators, deterministic screener boards, multi-question chat sessions, versioned append-only research artifacts with revision diff, typed DSH host tools, zero-dependency SVG cards.
author: vicfei
